scheme_name: National Scheme Of Welfare Of Fishermen
other_conditions: Must be a fisherman living in coastal areas and licensed by the respective State or Union Territory
Must be below 60 years of age
Must belong to the BPL (Below Poverty Line) category
Must be engaged in full‑time inland activities for inland fishermen or full‑time sea activities for marine fishermen
Marine fishermen must be a member of a Welfare Society, Federation, or Cooperative Society
Marine fishermen under FISHCOPFED are eligible only for the insurance component
benefits_summary: Provides financial assistance for constructing houses, community halls, tube wells, and insurance coverage to eligible fishermen.
